zh: 放弃"只有一个宇宙"：暴胀的假真空是 de Sitter 空间，每一刻都有真空泡随机成核、以光速扩张（Coleman–De Luccia 1980），每个泡里面是一个开放的 FLRW 宇宙。只要成核太慢，泡永远追不上空间的膨胀——暴胀永不结束，泡泡无穷无尽（Guth 1981；Vilenkin 1983；Linde 1986）。下面的泡沫由方程的速率实时生成。
en: Give up "there is only one universe": the false vacuum of inflation is de Sitter space, and at every moment vacuum bubbles nucleate at random and expand at the speed of light (Coleman–De Luccia 1980), each with an open FLRW universe inside. As long as nucleation is slow enough the bubbles never catch up with the expansion of space — inflation never ends and the bubbles are endless (Guth 1981; Vilenkin 1983; Linde 1986). The foam below is generated live from the rates in the equations.

zh: ① 永恒暴胀的泡沫 模拟
en: ① The foam of eternal inflation simulated

zh: 一个固定物理大小的窗口（边长 24/H），画面中心是你所在的共动点。泡按单位面积、单位时间的速率 λ 成核，物理半径按 $R = (e^{H\Delta t}-1)/H$ 长；两泡相遇画出碰撞线。按播放，看空间里永远有新泡冒出来、老泡被推走，而你迟早会被某个泡吞没。窗口被泡填满只说明你这一块到头了：窗口之外空间一直在翻倍，假真空的总面积照样在涨。
en: A window of fixed physical size (side 24/H); the center of the picture is your comoving point. Bubbles nucleate at a rate λ per unit area per unit time and their physical radius grows as $R = (e^{H\Delta t}-1)/H$; where two bubbles meet, a collision line is drawn. Press play and watch new bubbles keep appearing while old ones are pushed away, until sooner or later some bubble engulfs you. The window filling up with bubbles only means your patch is done: outside it space keeps doubling, and the total area of false vacuum keeps growing.

zh: ⟲ 重来
en: ⟲ Restart

zh: ✦ 换一个还在假真空的点
en: ✦ Switch to a point still in the false vacuum

zh: 成核率 $\lambda/H^3$（二维切片）
en: Nucleation rate $\lambda/H^3$ (2D slice)

zh: 对数刻度；超过 2/π ≈ 0.64 泡就会填满空间，暴胀结束（三维的阈值是 9/4π ≈ 0.72）
en: log scale; above 2/π ≈ 0.64 the bubbles fill space and inflation ends (the 3D threshold is 9/4π ≈ 0.72)

zh: 景观：每个泡随机抽一个宇宙学常数 Λ（颜色 = 能不能长出星系）
en: Landscape: each bubble draws a random cosmological constant Λ (color = whether galaxies can grow)

zh: ② 假真空的命运 模拟
en: ② The fate of the false vacuum simulated

zh: 一个共动点到 $Ht$ 还没被吞的概率 $p(t)$：解析式对模拟里量到的（窗口内的）假真空面积份额。假真空的物理面积 $\propto e^{2Ht}p(t)$，指数 $2 - \pi\lambda/H^3$ 决定暴胀永恒还是终止。
en: The probability $p(t)$ that a comoving point has not been engulfed by $Ht$: the analytic formula against the false-vacuum area fraction measured in the simulation (inside the window). The physical area of false vacuum is $\propto e^{2Ht}p(t)$, and the exponent $2 - \pi\lambda/H^3$ decides whether inflation is eternal or ends.

zh: 解析 p(t)模拟量到的假真空份额
en: analytic p(t)false-vacuum fraction measured in the simulation

zh: ③ 泡泡里面：你的宇宙 模拟
en: ③ Inside the bubble: your universe simulated

zh: CDL 泡的内部是一个 $k=-1$ 的开放 FLRW 宇宙，一开始曲率占满。泡里再暴胀 $N$ 个 e-fold，把曲率压到今天的 $\Omega_k \approx e^{-2(N-N_*)}$（$N_*\approx 60$，粗略）。被吞没后这张卡会告诉你：你的泡抽到了什么样的 Λ，能不能长出星系。
en: The interior of a CDL bubble is an open FLRW universe with $k=-1$, completely dominated by curvature at first. Inflating another $N$ e-folds inside the bubble squeezes the curvature down to today's $\Omega_k \approx e^{-2(N-N_*)}$ ($N_*\approx 60$, roughly). Once you are engulfed this card tells you what Λ your bubble drew and whether galaxies can grow.

zh: 泡里的暴胀 e-fold 数 $N$
en: Number of inflation e-folds inside the bubble $N$

zh: 把这个泡里的宇宙装进创世台 →
en: Load the universe inside this bubble into the Forge →

zh: ④ 景观与温伯格的彩票 模拟
en: ④ The landscape and Weinberg's lottery simulated

zh: 如果每个泡的 Λ 是从一个平坦的先验里抽的（弦景观的说法），那么绝大多数泡的 Λ 大到星系长不出来。下面按创世台的宜居诊断给每个 Λ 判一次（物质密度和原初扰动幅度取我们的；Λ < 0 的宇宙会回缩，判的是它一生里能不能长出星系）。
en: If each bubble's Λ is drawn from a flat prior (the string-landscape picture), then in the vast majority of bubbles Λ is so large that galaxies cannot grow. Below, each Λ is judged by the Forge's habitability diagnosis (matter density and primordial perturbation amplitude taken as ours; a universe with Λ < 0 recollapses, and what is judged is whether galaxies can grow within its lifetime).

zh: 读完你自己的发现之后再看：这个宇宙在说什么
en: Read after you have made your own discoveries: what this universe is saying

zh: 成核与膨胀的赛跑。假真空里 $a = e^{Ht}$。$t_n$ 成核的泡，共动半径 $r = (1-e^{-H(t-t_n)})/(Ha_n)$：它永远长不过 $1/(Ha_n)$——空间在它外面跑得更快。一个共动点到 $t$ 还在假真空里的概率是 $$p(t) = \exp\Big[-\tfrac{4\pi}{3}\tfrac{\lambda}{H^4}\int_0^{Ht}(1-e^{-x})^3dx\Big]\to\exp\Big[-\tfrac{4\pi}{3}\tfrac{\lambda}{H^4}\big(Ht-\tfrac{11}{6}\big)\Big],$$ 而假真空的物理体积 $\propto e^{3Ht}p(t)$。指数 $3 - \tfrac{4\pi}{3}\lambda/H^4$ 为正就永恒：$\lambda/H^4 < 9/4\pi$（Guth & Weinberg 1983）。画面是二维切片，对应的条件是 $\lambda_2/H^3 < 2/\pi$。慢滚暴胀也有同样的事（Vilenkin 1983；Linde 1986）：量子涨落让有些区域的场爬回去，那些区域的体积增长压过了衰变。
en: The race between nucleation and expansion. In the false vacuum $a = e^{Ht}$. A bubble nucleated at $t_n$ has comoving radius $r = (1-e^{-H(t-t_n)})/(Ha_n)$: it never grows beyond $1/(Ha_n)$ — space outside it runs away faster. The probability that a comoving point is still in the false vacuum at $t$ is $$p(t) = \exp\Big[-\tfrac{4\pi}{3}\tfrac{\lambda}{H^4}\int_0^{Ht}(1-e^{-x})^3dx\Big]\to\exp\Big[-\tfrac{4\pi}{3}\tfrac{\lambda}{H^4}\big(Ht-\tfrac{11}{6}\big)\Big],$$ while the physical volume of false vacuum is $\propto e^{3Ht}p(t)$. If the exponent $3 - \tfrac{4\pi}{3}\lambda/H^4$ is positive, inflation is eternal: $\lambda/H^4 < 9/4\pi$ (Guth & Weinberg 1983). The picture is a 2D slice, where the condition is $\lambda_2/H^3 < 2/\pi$. The same happens in slow-roll inflation (Vilenkin 1983; Linde 1986): quantum fluctuations make the field climb back up in some regions, and the volume growth of those regions outruns the decay.

zh: 泡里面。Coleman–De Luccia 的泡内部，从泡壁看是一个开放宇宙（$k = -1$）——泡壁本身就是这个宇宙的"大爆炸"面。于是"宇宙为什么这么平"要靠泡里再暴胀几十个 e-fold；反过来，如果只多暴胀了 60 个左右，今天就该测到一点点负曲率（$\Omega_k\sim10^{-3}$ 量级，Planck 的上限是 0.002）。泡与泡相撞在我们的 CMB 上留下圆盘状的温度斑（Aguirre, Johnson & Kleban 2007）；Planck 数据里没找到（Feeney 等 2011）。
en: Inside the bubble. Seen from the bubble wall, the interior of a Coleman–De Luccia bubble is an open universe ($k = -1$) — the wall itself is this universe's "big bang" surface. So "why is the universe so flat" has to rely on a few dozen more e-folds of inflation inside the bubble; conversely, if there were only about 60 extra e-folds, a little negative curvature should be measurable today ($\Omega_k\sim10^{-3}$; Planck's limit is 0.002). Collisions between bubbles leave disc-shaped temperature patches on our CMB (Aguirre, Johnson & Kleban 2007); none were found in the Planck data (Feeney et al. 2011).

zh: 温伯格的彩票。1987 年温伯格指出：若 Λ 从一个光滑的先验里抽，只有 $\Lambda$ 不超过观测值几百倍的宇宙长得出星系，所以观察者看到的 Λ 应该在这个范围里而且不会太小——这在 1998 年前就预言了一个不为零的小 Λ。④里每个泡的判决用的是创世台同一套宜居诊断。它是不是科学？争议点在"测度问题"：无穷多个泡里怎么数比例，至今没有公认答案。
en: Weinberg's lottery. In 1987 Weinberg pointed out that if Λ is drawn from a smooth prior, only universes with $\Lambda$ no more than a few hundred times the observed value grow galaxies, so observers should see a Λ within this range and not too small — a prediction of a small non-zero Λ before 1998. The verdict for each bubble in ④ uses the same habitability diagnosis as the Forge. Is it science? The controversy is the "measure problem": how to count proportions among infinitely many bubbles has no agreed answer to this day.

zh: 标签：泡沫、碰撞、份额、曲率全由方程算（模拟）；Λ 的先验是假设（平坦）；碰撞的 CMB 印记和 Planck 的结果引自文献。
en: Labels: foam, collisions, fractions and curvature are all computed from the equations (simulated); the prior on Λ is an assumption (flat); the CMB imprint of collisions and the Planck results are quoted from the literature.
